# Inventory export

Current state: novel-work planning, wayfinding active.

[Decision map](../../docs/planning/export/map.md).
[Design](../../docs/planning/export/design.md).

The agreed work includes CSV export, empty-inventory behavior, and behavior when the destination file already exists. CSV with name and quantity columns is agreed. Empty-inventory behavior and existing-file behavior are both open and unblocked. Current question: empty-inventory behavior.

steps.prompt: Two more export choices are unresolved: whether to include items whose quantity is zero, and whether to sort output alphabetically by item name.
Before choosing, which export questions remain open?

rubric.description: Adds zero-quantity inclusion and alphabetical ordering as open questions in the existing export feature record and updates its decision map/index.
Preserves the previously open empty-inventory and destination-exists questions and the accepted CSV name/quantity columns.
Does not turn either new question into an accepted answer and does not create a separate planning ticket for each related refinement.
The follow-up names all four open product choices clearly and usefully, without repeating a full planning map unnecessarily.
Keeps production source unchanged, planning active, and no work published.
